App.name: FieldKit
App.description: Sales Force Automation — field app & back office.

Home.title: FieldKit
Home.description: The field app & back office. The design system is live — shadcn/ui, Tailwind, and the FieldKit tokens (teal accent, light & dark).

Localization.title: Localized, not just translated
Localization.description: {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}} shipped. Money, quantities and timestamps all render through the active locale.
Localization.timeZoneNote: Stored in UTC, displayed in the user's timezone (ADR-0010).

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: FieldKit never sees your password — your workspace's identity provider handles it.
Login.workspaceHint: The workspace your administrator gave you. We'll remember it on this device.
Login.workspaceInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
Login.unconfigured: Sign-in is unavailable: no identity provider is configured for this deployment.
Login.redirectFailed: Couldn't reach the identity provider. Check the workspace name and try again.

Callback.title: Signing you in
Callback.description: Finishing up — this only takes a moment.
Callback.failedDescription: The sign-in link was already used or has expired. Starting again will fix it.

Session.title: Your session
Session.apiUnreachable: Signed in, but the API didn't accept the token. It may be offline.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: That route doesn't exist — it may have moved, or the link may be out of date.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.description: FieldKit couldn't reach the server. Anything you've already captured is stored on this device and syncs as soon as you reconnect.
Offline.hint: Install FieldKit to your home screen so it keeps working in dead zones.

Outlets.title: Outlets
Outlets.caption: Outlets with their classification, territory and status.
Outlets.failed: The outlet base could not be loaded.
Outlets.forbidden: You do not have permission to view outlets.
Outlets.empty: No outlets yet. Import them or add the first one.

OutletForm.name: Outlet name
OutletForm.failed: The outlet could not be saved.
OutletForm.noContacts: No contacts recorded for this outlet.

Validation.mustBeDate: Must be a date as YYYY-MM-DD.

OutletImport.title: Import outlets
OutletImport.intro: Upload a CSV, check what it would do, then apply it. Checking runs every rule and writes nothing.
OutletImport.atMost: At most {max, number} rows per file.
OutletImport.tooBig: This file has {rows, number} rows; at most {max, number} can be imported at a time. Split it and import the parts.
OutletImport.modeAllOrNothingHint: One bad row and the whole file is refused. Best for a short list someone typed.
OutletImport.modePartialHint: The refused rows come back as a file to fix and send again. Best for a large export.
OutletImport.checked: {accepted, plural, =0 {No rows are} one {# row is} other {# rows are}} ready to import, {rejected, plural, =0 {none were} one {# was} other {# were}} refused. Nothing has been written yet.
OutletImport.applied: {imported, plural, =0 {No outlets} one {# outlet} other {# outlets}} imported, {rejected, plural, =0 {no rows} one {# row} other {# rows}} refused.
OutletImport.nothingWritten: Nothing was written, because this file was set to import nothing when a row is bad.
OutletImport.ignoredColumns: These columns were ignored: {columns}. Check for a mistyped custom-field header.
OutletImport.problemsCaption: Rows the import refused, with the reason for each.
OutletImport.failed: The file could not be imported.
OutletImport.fixHint: Edit the flagged cells, then check again.
OutletImport.fixCaption: The refused rows, editable, with the reason each was refused.
OutletImport.tooManyToFix: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number} refused rows. For the rest, download them and fix the file.
OutletImport.excluded: {count, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} unchecked and will not be imported.
OutletImport.wereExcluded: {count, plural, one {# row was} other {# rows were}} unchecked and left out of this run.
OutletImport.stale: The file has changed since it was checked. Check it again before applying.
